# DRAFT (not filed): Launchpad bug against python-django (Ubuntu 24.04 noble)

**Suggested title:** python-django 3:4.2.11-1ubuntu1.18 (noble): bytes values still reach GDALRaster in spatial lookups (upstream CVE-2026-87890)

**Package / series:** python-django, noble (24.04), version `3:4.2.11-1ubuntu1.18`.

## Summary

noble's CVE-2026-15307 backport leaves the bytes path that upstream closed as CVE-2026-87890; our calibrated probe shows it.

No exploitability claim is made here: this report says what a test observes in the packaged code, nothing about whether it can be exploited.

## What was run

- **Subject:** the noble source package rebuilt as a git line by [Heirloom](https://github.com/iamdflame/heirloom): `python-django_4.2.11.orig.tar.gz` plus the 48 patches of `3:4.2.11-1ubuntu1.18`, one commit per patch, tip `f566e91a2c`. The `.dsc` sha256 was verified against its download; its signature was **not** verified. `diff -r` of `django/` against the orig tarball was empty before the patches were applied. ([distro_lines.json](https://github.com/iamdflame/heirloom/blob/e391f81ec676448dfa55d56c9866676f28b6404c/evals/distro_lines.json) records URLs and sha256s.)
- **Upstream fix:** Django 5.2.x commit [`dd0558d161`](https://github.com/django/django/commit/dd0558d1617619e0d66163675ef02135d0f54e5f), "Fixed CVE-2026-87890 -- Blocked bytes in spatial lookups." ([advisory](https://www.djangoproject.com/weblog/2026/oct/06/security-releases/)). Its parent is `6ecd66e09a`.
- **Probe:** `SpatialLookupBytesTests.test_bytes_lookup_values_never_reach_gdalraster`, source in [heirloom/lines/handwritten.py](https://github.com/iamdflame/heirloom/blob/e391f81ec676448dfa55d56c9866676f28b6404c/heirloom/lines/handwritten.py). It replaces `GDALRaster` with a recorder that raises before any GDAL I/O and passes bytes to `PointField.get_prep_value` and `RasterField.get_prep_value`, so nothing is read, written or fetched. It asserts that no bytes value reaches `GDALRaster`.
- **The probe is hand-written** (to a spec in the Heirloom build brief); it is not model-generated and not from Heirloom's independent porter. [matrix.json](https://github.com/iamdflame/heirloom/blob/e391f81ec676448dfa55d56c9866676f28b6404c/evals/matrix.json) records this in the cell's `probe.origin` field: "hand-written (BUILD-BRIEF §10.4 spec); not from the independent porter".

    "v2": "v2 · Heirloom (calibrated)",
    "v1": "v1 · naive (cherry-pick + LLM, no calibration)",
}


def pct(x: float | None) -> str:
    return "n/a" if x is None else f"{100 * x:.0f}%"


def cost_note(data: dict[str, Any]) -> str:
    rows = [r for runs in data.get("runs", {}).values() for r in runs.values()]
    priced = [r for r in rows if r.get("cost_usd")]
    est = [r for r in priced if r.get("cost_estimated", True)]
    return (
        f"$ figures: {len(priced) - len(est)} of {len(priced)} priced cases use provider-reported "
        f"cost (OpenRouter `usage.cost`, `claude -p` `total_cost_usd` on OpenRouter); the other "
        f"{len(est)} are token × list-price estimates from the LiteLLM gateway, which billed "
        "roughly twice that on 2026-10-11 (see hackathon.md), so treat those as lower bounds."
    )


def table(data: dict[str, Any]) -> str:
    rows = [
        "| Pipeline | Cases | Verdict accuracy (decided) | False NOT_AFFECTED | "
        "False AFFECTED | UNPROVEN | Fellows' 4.2 test passes | Escalation rate | "
        "$ / case | Min / case |",
        "|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|",
    ]
    for name in ("v2", "v1"):
        s = data.get("summary", {}).get(name)
        if not s:
            continue
        usd = "n/a" if s["usd_per_case"] is None else f"${s['usd_per_case']:.2f}"
        unknown = f" (+{s['cost_unknown_cases']} unknown)" if s["cost_unknown_cases"] else ""
        rows.append(
            f"| {LABELS[name]} | {s['cases']} | {pct(s['verdict_accuracy'])} "
            f"({s['decided']} decided) | **{s['false_not_affected']}** | "
            f"{s['false_affected']} | {s['unproven']} | {s['fellows_test_pass']} | "
            f"{pct(s['escalation_rate'])} | {usd}{unknown} | {s['minutes_per_case']} |"
        )
    per_case = [
        "",
        "<details><summary>Per case</summary>",
        "",
        "| CVE | Case | Truth | v2 verdict | v2 fellows' test | v1 verdict | v1 fellows' test |",
        "|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|",
    ]
    runs = data.get("runs", {})
    keys = sorted(set(runs.get("v2", {})) | set(runs.get("v1", {})))
    for k in keys:
        a, b = runs.get("v2", {}).get(k, {}), runs.get("v1", {}).get(k, {})
        base = a or b
        reason = f" ({a['reason']})" if a.get("reason") not in (None, "NONE") else ""
        per_case.append(
            f"| {base['cve']} | {base['kind']} | {base['truth']} | "
            f"{a.get('verdict', '—')}{reason} | "
            f"{a.get('fellows_test_passes', '—')} | {b.get('verdict', '—')} | "
            f"{b.get('fellows_test_passes', '—')} |"
        )
    per_case += ["", "</details>"]
    note = (
        f"\n_Set `{data.get('set')}`; rendered from [`evals/results.json`](evals/results.json) "
        "by `evals/render_readme.py`. Accuracy counts only decided cases; UNPROVEN means "
        "Heirloom declined to claim either way and would ask a human. "
        f"{cost_note(data)}_"
    )
    return "\n".join(rows) + note + "\n" + "\n".join(per_case)


def main() -> int:
    data = json.loads(RESULTS.read_text())
    text = README.read_text()
    block = f"{START}\n{table(data)}\n{END}"
    if START in text and END in text:
        head, rest = text.split(START, 1)
        _, tail = rest.split(END, 1)
        text = head + block + tail
    else:
        text = text.rstrip() + "\n\n## E1 backtest: Django 4.2, 2026 CVEs\n\n" + block + "\n"
    README.write_text(text)
    print(f"rendered {README}")
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())

"""Export the campaign facts the README needs that results_live.json does not carry.

    uv run python evals/export_campaign_evidence.py

Reads the local ledger (work/ledger.sqlite), policy/precedents.json and
evals/results_live.json; writes evals/campaign_evidence.json:

- ``fail_to_pass``: for every PR in results_live, the latest finished VERIFY stage's
  probe outcomes before and after the fix (FAIL→PASS when the backport works);
- ``questions``: every question issue opened by the campaign's CVEs on its line
  (decide.question stages since the campaign started), with the CVEs that waited on it;
- ``precedents``: stored answers, and the CVEs whose DECIDE applied each one.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import json
import sqlite3
import sys
from datetime import UTC, datetime
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent
LIVE = ROOT / "evals" / "results_live.json"
LEDGER = ROOT / "work" / "ledger.sqlite"
PRECEDENTS = ROOT / "policy" / "precedents.json"
OUT = ROOT / "evals" / "campaign_evidence.json"


def iso(ts: float) -> str:
    return datetime.fromtimestamp(ts, UTC).strftime("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ")


def main() -> int:
    live = json.loads(LIVE.read_text())
    line = live["line"]
    since = datetime.strptime(live["created_at"], "%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ").replace(tzinfo=UTC)
    db = sqlite3.connect(LEDGER)
    db.row_factory = sqlite3.Row
    cves = sorted(live["per_cve"])

    fail_to_pass = []
    for cve, rec in sorted(live["per_cve"].items()):
        if "/pull/" not in rec.get("link", ""):
            continue
        row = db.execute(
            "SELECT run_id, trace_id, output_json FROM stages WHERE cve=? AND line=? "
            "AND stage='verify' AND status='done' ORDER BY started_at DESC LIMIT 1",
            (cve, line),
        ).fetchone()
        out = json.loads(row["output_json"]) if row else {}
        fail_to_pass.append(
            {
                "cve": cve,
                "pr": rec["link"],
                "run_id": row["run_id"] if row else None,
                "trace_id": row["trace_id"] if row else None,
                "probe_before": out.get("probe_before"),
                "probe_after": out.get("probe_after"),
                "verify_ok": bool(out.get("ok")),
                "fail_to_pass": set(out.get("probe_before") or ["?"]) == {"FAIL"}
                and set(out.get("probe_after") or ["?"]) == {"PASS"},
            }
        )

    marks = ",".join("?" * len(cves))
    questions: dict[str, dict[str, Any]] = {}
    for r in db.execute(
        f"SELECT cve, run_id, trace_id, span_id, started_at, output_json FROM stages "
        f"WHERE stage='decide.question' AND status='done' AND line=? AND cve IN ({marks}) "
        "AND started_at >= ? ORDER BY started_at, rowid",
        (line, *cves, since.timestamp()),
    ):
        url = json.loads(r["output_json"] or "{}").get("url", "")
        q = questions.setdefault(
            url,
            {
                "issue": url,
                "asked_by": r["cve"],
                "asking_trace": r["trace_id"],
                "asking_span": r["span_id"],
                "asked_at": iso(r["started_at"]),
                "waited": [],
            },
        )
        if r["cve"] != q["asked_by"] and r["cve"] not in q["waited"]:
            q["waited"].append(r["cve"])

    precedents = []
    for p in json.loads(PRECEDENTS.read_text()):
        applied = []
        for r in db.execute(
            f"SELECT cve, run_id, trace_id, output_json FROM stages WHERE stage='decide' "
            f"AND status='done' AND line=? AND cve IN ({marks}) ORDER BY started_at, rowid",
            (line, *cves),
        ):
            out = json.loads(r["output_json"] or "{}")
            if (out.get("precedent") or {}).get("id") == p["id"] and not out.get("asked"):
                applied.append(
                    {
                        "cve": r["cve"],
                        "run_id": r["run_id"],
                        "trace_id": r["trace_id"],
                        "decision": out.get("decision"),
                        "pr": live["per_cve"][r["cve"]].get("link", ""),
                    }
                )
        precedents.append(
            {
                "id": p["id"],
                "kind": p["kind"],
                "scope": p["scope"],
                "answer": p["answer"],
                "issue": p["issue_url"],
                "stored_at": iso(p["created_at"]),
                "applied_by": applied,
            }
        )

    doc = {
        "campaign": live["campaign"],
        "line": line,
        "source": "work/ledger.sqlite + policy/precedents.json + evals/results_live.json",
        "fail_to_pass": fail_to_pass,
        "questions": list(questions.values()),
        "precedents": precedents,
    }
    OUT.write_text(json.dumps(doc, indent=2) + "\n")
    print(f"wrote {OUT}: {len(fail_to_pass)} PRs, {len(questions)} question(s)")
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())

- **DECIDE:** real choices (behaviour differences, upstream test rewrites) open one question issue;
  the answer is stored as a precedent and reused.
- **PUBLISH:** a PR with one claim per fact, each linked to its neatlogs span and run artifact (a claim
  missing either is struck), or an evidence issue when there is no verified fix.
